parts.covers: Recorded approved payment counts and amounts by tender (cash, UPI, card). MDR and refunds for UPI are recorded in upi-settlements-june; cash handling costs and card interchange fees are not recorded.
parts.sql: select "pos-payments-june"."tender" as "tender", count(*) as "approved_count", sum("pos-payments-june"."amount_inr") as "total_amount_inr", avg("pos-payments-june"."amount_inr") as "avg_amount_inr" from "pos-payments-june"  where ("pos-payments-june"."till_status" = ?) group by "pos-payments-june"."tender" order by "tender" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From payment attempt records; keep rows where pos payments.till_status = 'approved'; group by pos payments.tender; report tender = pos payments.tender, approved_count = count of *, total_amount_inr = sum of pos payments.amount_inr, avg_amount_inr = avg of pos payments.amount_inr; sorted by tender asc.

parts.covers: Recorded UPI settlement totals: gross credits, MDR, refunds, net credited, and transaction count. MDR is the only recorded UPI cost; cash handling costs and card fees are not recorded.
parts.sql: select sum("upi-settlements-june"."gross_inr") as "total_gross_inr", sum("upi-settlements-june"."mdr_inr") as "total_mdr_inr", sum("upi-settlements-june"."refunds_inr") as "total_refunds_inr", sum("upi-settlements-june"."net_inr") as "total_net_inr", sum("upi-settlements-june"."upi_credits") as "total_credits" from "upi-settlements-june"  limit 1
parts.plan_in_words: From UPI settlement records; report total_gross_inr = sum of upi settlements.gross_inr, total_mdr_inr = sum of upi settlements.mdr_inr, total_refunds_inr = sum of upi settlements.refunds_inr, total_net_inr = sum of upi settlements.net_inr, total_credits = sum of upi settlements.upi_credits.

parts.plan_in_words: From complaint records; keep rows where customer complaints.kind = 'charged twice'; group by customer complaints.kind; report complaint_kind = customer complaints.kind, count = count of *, total_amount_inr = sum of customer complaints.amount_inr, resolution_types = count distinct of customer complaints.resolution.

parts.plan_in_words: From payment attempt records; keep rows where pos payments.tender = 'UPI' and pos payments.till_status in ['failed', 'failed: no response']; group by pos payments.till_status; report till_status = pos payments.till_status, count = count of *, total_amount_inr = sum of pos payments.amount_inr.

parts.plan_in_words: From UPI refund records; keep rows where upi refunds.requested_ts between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30; report refund_count = count of *, refund_ids = count distinct of upi refunds.refund_id, bill_ids = count distinct of upi refunds.bill_id, total_amount_inr = sum of upi refunds.amount_inr, triggers = count distinct of upi refunds.trigger.
